observations: Six reduced kinds lower and agree with source Node in both backends, including ASan/UBSan and leak checks. Two examples reproduce historical signatures before the change and advance after it. Five other examples already reach different stops in the smallest selected unit before this change. No census-wide 43-site unlock is claimed.
inference: All six kinds use the existing boxed-union pointer ABI. Unboxed scalar callable views still need adapters and stay NotYet. Library intrinsic callback adapters retain their existing source-signature behavior.
scope: Minimal shared hooks censusCallableSlotless and sameKeeping. No IR, backend, flow or runtime C changes. Two obsolete refusal-test rows are covered by the diagnostic fixture. No code copied from cohere.
commands: Guarded replay workers generated with stage3/census/latent/make_overlay.py; go build -buildvcs=false -overlay=SCRATCH/overlay.json -o WORKER ./stage3/census/latent/replay/worker; workers use -project /tmp/function-values-census-input/src/tsc/tsc.ts -where EXACT_EXAMPLE -kind NotYet -reason EXACT_CENSUS_REASON.
git diff --check; gofmt on changed Go files; focused tests only, no whole packages or full gate.
